test_cases.title: Test ONE-to-ONE mapping between Prescription and Patient Consultation Request
preconditions: A prescription is generated for Patient Consultation Request REQ-001.
steps: Retrieve prescription PRS-001.
Verify that it is mapped to Patient Consultation Request REQ-001 only.
expected: Prescription PRS-001 is mapped to Patient Consultation Request REQ-001.

test_cases.title: Test Chemist receives ONE OR MORE prescriptions
preconditions: A Chemist with Pincode CHEM-001 exists.

expected: Chemist CHEM-001 receives prescriptions PRS-001 and PRS-002.

test_cases.title: Test ONE-to-ONE mapping between Prescription and Chemist using Pincode
preconditions: Prescription PRS-001 exists.

expected: Prescription PRS-001 is mapped to Chemist CHEM-001.

test_cases.title: Test Lab receives ONE OR MORE prescriptions
preconditions: A Lab with Pincode LAB-001 exists.

expected: Lab LAB-001 receives prescriptions PRS-001 and PRS-002.

test_cases.title: Test ONE-to-ONE mapping between Prescription and Lab using Pincode
preconditions: Prescription PRS-001 exists.
steps: Map prescription PRS-001 to Lab LAB-001 using Pincode.
Verify that prescription PRS-001 is mapped to Lab LAB-001 only.
expected: Prescription PRS-001 is mapped to Lab LAB-001.

test_cases.title: Negative test: Attempt to generate MORE THAN ONE prescription for a single Patient Consultation Request
preconditions: A valid Patient Consultation Request is created.
steps: Submit Patient Consultation Request REQ-001 twice.
Verify the number of generated prescriptions.
expected: Exactly ONE prescription is generated, not more.

test_cases.title: Negative test: Attempt to map a Prescription to MULTIPLE Patient Consultation Requests
preconditions: Prescription PRS-001 exists.
steps: Attempt to map prescription PRS-001 to Patient Consultation Requests REQ-001 and REQ-002.
expected: Prescription PRS-001 is mapped to only ONE Patient Consultation Request.

test_cases.title: Boundary test: Verify mapping of a Prescription to a Chemist at the minimum threshold (single prescription)
preconditions: Prescription PRS-001 exists.
steps: Map prescription PRS-001 to Chemist CHEM-001 using Pincode.
Verify the mapping.
expected: Prescription PRS-001 is mapped to Chemist CHEM-001.

test_cases.title: Boundary test: Verify mapping of a Prescription to a Lab at the maximum threshold (multiple prescriptions)
preconditions: Prescriptions PRS-001 and PRS-002 exist.
steps: Map prescriptions PRS-001 and PRS-002 to Lab LAB-001 using Pincode.
Verify each prescription is mapped to Lab LAB-001.
expected: Each prescription (PRS-001, PRS-002) is mapped to Lab LAB-001.
